---
title: "Stage 1: Programming from first principles"
---

Python through transport data from the first cell: variables, types, collections, loops, conditionals and functions, then modules, imports and `pandas`. Engineering practice is part of the work from the start: reading a traceback, `assert`, the debugger and `pytest`. The dataset is STATS19 road collisions for one area over a few years, and the task is to read it, clean it and distrust it.

Notebooks for this stage appear in the sidebar as they are published. Each one is readable here in full, with its code and output.
